record.question: The nurse is caring for a client who is tearfully expressing feelings of worthlessness after a bilateral mastectomy. Which communication technique is most appropriate for the nurse to use?
options: Many women have body image concerns after this surgery.
Tell me more about how you feel.
Why do you feel depressed and worthless?
Your feelings of depression will be better in the morning.
record.explanation: Answer B: Tell me more about how you feel.. An open-ended invitation such as “Tell me more about how you feel” encourages expression without judging or minimizing the patient’s emotions. Reference: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK568801/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
